name: Easy AI SEO
author: easyai2025

sections.description:
IMPORTANT: To use Easy AI SEO, you must first create an account with OpenAI, generate an API key, and fund your API account. By connecting directly to OpenAI, you avoid middlemen and inflated credit prices that other AI applications charge.

Use this plugin alongside your favorite SEO toolkit (like AIOSEO or others) for best results. We’ll handle the advice; they handle the settings.

Easy AI SEO is designed to help you create SEO suggestions using artificial intelligence in the simplest possible format. It is ideal for beginners and for those intimidated by SEO. The plugin can answer questions or generate content by using General AI Query, SEO keyword suggestions, content improvement recommendations, suggest SEO for images and even image generation ideas—all via AI, with the only quantity limit being your API funding. And even more to come.

The plugin now features comprehensive step-by-step instructions for all features, making it even more accessible for beginners. Each tab contains detailed guidance on how to use the tools effectively, with examples and best practices.

Easy AI SEO includes a streamlined workflow with tabs organized in a logical sequence from content creation to SEO optimization. It supports various art styles for image generation and provides detailed readability scoring with interpretation guidelines.

The suggestions are produced using your content on the page and are meant to be manually placed into your SEO program. Create Image SEO directly in the Image page in the Media library. We recommend using Slim SEO or AIOSEO for easy integration of this data into SEO fields—AIOSEO offers more control and feedback while requiring a basic understanding of SEO.

Getting Started with WordPress SEO Optimization

After installing Easy AI SEO WordPress plugin, follow these steps to boost your WordPress SEO rankings:

  1. Connect Your WordPress Site to OpenAI

    • Navigate to WordPress Admin → Settings → Easy AI SEO
    • Enter your OpenAI API key to power WordPress SEO analysis
    • Select GPT-4 model for the most advanced WordPress SEO suggestions

  2. Analyze WordPress SEO for Any Post

    • Open any WordPress post or create new WordPress content
    • Locate the Easy AI SEO WordPress integration box below the WordPress editor
    • Input your WordPress SEO focus keyword
    • Click “Generate WordPress SEO Keywords” for AI-powered optimization

  3. Track WordPress SEO Score with the SEO Scorecard

    • Monitor your WordPress SEO score (displayed prominently in the scorecard)
    • Green metrics indicate WordPress SEO best practices
    • Yellow metrics need WordPress SEO improvements
    • Red metrics require immediate WordPress SEO fixes
    • Each WordPress SEO metric provides actionable WordPress optimization tips

  4. Optimize WordPress Content with AI SEO Suggestions

    • Apply AI WordPress SEO suggestions to your WordPress content
    • Re-analyze WordPress SEO metrics to track improvement
    • Continue WordPress SEO optimization until you achieve top scores
    • Monitor WordPress SEO improvements directly in your dashboard

  5. Leverage Premium WordPress SEO Features

    • Check WordPress content freshness on existing WordPress posts
    • Improve WordPress semantic relevance for better topic coverage
    • Generate SEO-optimized WordPress images with AI
    • Create voice search optimized WordPress content

WordPress SEO Feature Tutorials

Maximizing WordPress SEO with the SEO Scorecard

The WordPress SEO Scorecard provides comprehensive WordPress site optimization insights:

  1. Open any WordPress post or page in your WordPress dashboard
  2. Find the Easy AI SEO WordPress integration below the WordPress content editor
  3. View your current WordPress SEO score at the top of the WordPress meta box
  4. Each WordPress SEO metric displays a clear status indicator:
    • Green checkmark: WordPress SEO optimized (complete)
    • Yellow dot: WordPress SEO needs improvement (partial)
    • Red X: WordPress SEO requires immediate attention (incomplete)
  5. Click any WordPress SEO metric for AI-generated WordPress optimization tips
  6. Implement the WordPress SEO suggestions directly in your WordPress content
  7. Click “Refresh WordPress SEO Analysis” to update your WordPress SEO score
  8. Continue optimizing until your WordPress content achieves maximum SEO potential

WordPress Content Freshness Optimization for Higher Rankings

Improve WordPress content freshness for better search positions:

  1. Open any existing WordPress post in your WordPress dashboard
  2. Locate the “WordPress Content Freshness” metric in the WordPress SEO Scorecard
  3. The WordPress SEO status will indicate:
    • SEO Fresh: WordPress content updated within 90 days (optimal for rankings)
    • Partially SEO Fresh: WordPress content updated 90-180 days ago
    • SEO Stale: WordPress content not updated in over 180 days (harmful to rankings)
  4. For SEO-stale WordPress content, click the “Get Revised WordPress Content” button
  5. Review the AI-generated WordPress content updates optimized for current SEO
  6. Incorporate the suggested updates into your WordPress post
  7. Update your WordPress post to refresh the content date
  8. Your WordPress Content Freshness metric will update to “SEO Fresh” status

Semantic WordPress SEO Optimization for Topic Authority

Enhance WordPress semantic relevance for better topic ranking:

  1. Enter your WordPress focus keyword in the designated WordPress SEO field
  2. Click the “WordPress Semantic Relevance” metric in the WordPress SEO scorecard
  3. Review the list of semantically related terms Google expects in quality WordPress content
  4. Note which WordPress SEO terms are already present in your content (green)
  5. Identify missing WordPress SEO terms needed for topic authority (red)
  6. Integrate missing terms naturally into your WordPress content
  7. Aim to include at least 75% of suggested terms for optimal WordPress SEO
  8. Click “Refresh WordPress SEO Analysis” to update your semantic WordPress SEO score
  9. Continue adding terms until your WordPress content achieves “SEO Complete” status

AI-Powered WordPress Keyword Optimization

Generate optimal WordPress SEO keywords for higher rankings:

  1. Create your WordPress post content in the WordPress editor
  2. Enter a primary focus keyword in the Easy AI SEO WordPress meta box
  3. Click the “Generate WordPress SEO Keywords” button
  4. Wait briefly while AI analyzes your WordPress content optimization potential
  5. Review the list of suggested primary and secondary WordPress SEO keywords
  6. Click any WordPress SEO keyword to automatically copy for insertion
  7. Implement these WordPress SEO keywords in your title, headings, and content
  8. Place primary WordPress SEO keywords in high-impact positions (WordPress title, H1, first paragraph)
  9. Distribute secondary WordPress SEO keywords throughout your WordPress content
  10. Maintain natural keyword integration for optimal WordPress SEO performance

External Services

This plugin relies on external third‑party APIs to provide its AI‑powered SEO suggestions and content improvements. The following details outline which services are used, what data is transmitted, and when:

OpenAI API
What it is & Used For:
The OpenAI API is used to generate SEO keyword suggestions, field‑specific recommendations, content replacement ideas, headline improvements, voice search optimization suggestions, readability improvements, and image generation (via DALL·E 3).
What Data is Sent & When:

Data Sent: The plugin transmits textual content from your post (including title, content, meta fields, and focus keywords) and custom query prompts. Your OpenAI API key is used solely for authentication with OpenAI.
When: Data is sent each time you use features such as generating SEO keywords, improving content, or creating custom images.
Links:
OpenAI Terms of Use – https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use/
OpenAI Privacy Policy – https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy/

Additional Notes

Easy AI SEO is built to simplify the creation of SEO suggestions using AI. It does not automatically populate your SEO fields; instead, it gives you suggestions that you then input into your SEO plugin (we recommend AIOSEO for ease of use). For more details, please refer to the plugin page on WordPress.org.
sections.installation:
1. Click Install Now.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Settings → Easy AI SEO and enter your OpenAI API key. (Remember: you must have an OpenAI account and a funded API key.) This is much cheaper than having to use a system where you buy credits at inflated prices.
  4. Enjoy the free features for generating SEO keyword suggestions, content ideas, and more.
  5. For premium features (such as content replacement suggestions, voice search optimization, custom image generation, headline SEO improvements, and link suggestions), upgrade your license via the Freemius integration.
sections.faq:
Is it difficult to obtain and fund an OpenAI API key?

Not at all! While it may initially seem intimidating, obtaining and funding an OpenAI API key is a straightforward process. First, create an account at openai.com, then navigate to the API section and create a new API key. To fund your account, simply add a payment method in the billing section. The minimum deposit is just $5, and OpenAI provides clear usage metrics so you can monitor your spending. Most users find that the process takes less than 5 minutes to complete, and our plugin provides step-by-step instructions to guide you through it.

What is OpenAI and how does it relate to ChatGPT?

OpenAI is the technology company that created and operates ChatGPT, the popular AI chatbot. While most people are familiar with ChatGPT as a consumer-facing service, OpenAI also provides powerful AI capabilities directly to developers through their API. This plugin connects to the same underlying AI technology that powers ChatGPT, but through a direct API connection, giving you more control and significantly lower costs compared to consumer-facing AI tools or third-party services.

Do I need an OpenAI API key?

Yes. You must create an account with OpenAI, generate an API key, and fund your API account. This direct connection means you pay only OpenAI’s rates—no middlemen or inflated prices.

Who is this plugin for?

Easy AI SEO is made for beginners and users who find SEO intimidating and time consuming. It provides simple, AI‑generated suggestions for SEO keyword placement and content optimization that you can integrate into other SEO plugins. We highly recommend AIOSEO to easily paste the suggestions into the appropriate fields.

What are the premium features?

The premium version (marked as “Plus Feature” throughout the plugin) includes:
– Content Replacement Suggestions: Natural ways to integrate keywords into your content.
– Improvement Suggestions: Readability and SEO improvement tips.
– Custom Image Generation: Generate images via DALL·E 3 with over 50 art styles.
– Headline SEO Suggestions: Get improved headline variations.
– Voice Search Optimizations: Receive voice search query suggestions.
– External & Internal Link Suggestions: Propose relevant links.
– Similar Topics Suggestions: Ideas for additional posts.
– Revised Content Generation: Create fully optimized blog posts with one click.

How does the plugin use OpenAI’s API?

The plugin communicates directly with OpenAI’s API to process your content and generate SEO suggestions. When you use features like keyword generation or content improvement, your post content is sent to OpenAI through their secure API. This approach ensures you get the highest quality AI suggestions while maintaining direct control over your API usage and costs.

How much does it cost to use the OpenAI API with this plugin?

OpenAI’s pricing is based on token usage (approximately 750 words per 1,000 tokens). For most blog posts, a single SEO analysis might cost between $0.01-$0.10 USD depending on content length and the specific features used. The plugin is designed to be efficient with token usage. Premium features like image generation via DALL-E 3 have separate pricing through OpenAI.

Can I use this plugin with other SEO plugins?

Yes, Easy AI SEO is designed to work alongside other WordPress SEO plugins in a complimentary fashion. It generates suggestions that you can manually copy and paste into your preferred SEO plugin’s fields. We recommend using it with Slim SEO or AIOSEO for the best integration experience, but it’s compatible with any SEO plugin that allows manual field editing.

What WordPress version is required?

Easy AI SEO requires WordPress 5.0 or higher and has been tested up to WordPress 6.7. For optimal performance, we recommend using the latest version of WordPress.

How do I interpret the readability score?

The plugin uses the Flesch-Kincaid Reading Ease formula to calculate readability. Higher scores (90-100) indicate content that is very easy to read, while lower scores (0-30) suggest more complex, academic content. The plugin provides a detailed interpretation of your score along with specific improvement suggestions tailored to your content. Please understand, This is more of a measure of the readers ability, so higher scores are more important if your content is designed for certain audiences.

Does the plugin automatically update my SEO fields?

No, Easy AI SEO generates suggestions that you need to manually implement. This approach gives you full control over what changes are made to your content and SEO fields. The plugin will never automatically modify your content without your review and approval.

How does the WordPress SEO Scorecard improve my site’s rankings?

The WordPress SEO Scorecard provides a comprehensive analysis of 12 critical WordPress SEO factors that directly impact search rankings. Unlike other WordPress SEO plugins that only check basics, Easy AI SEO analyzes advanced metrics including keyword optimization, WordPress title optimization, WordPress content structure, keyword density, WordPress content freshness, and semantic relevance – all factors WordPress sites need for higher rankings. Each WordPress SEO metric contributes to your overall WordPress SEO score, with intuitive visual indicators showing optimization status. Click any WordPress SEO metric for AI-powered suggestions specific to WordPress content.

How does the WordPress Content Freshness check improve search rankings?

WordPress Content Freshness is a critical ranking factor in Google’s algorithm that many WordPress SEO plugins overlook. Easy AI SEO automatically monitors how recently your WordPress content was updated, as search engines prioritize fresh WordPress content. The plugin analyzes WordPress publish and modified dates against Google’s freshness preferences: content under 90 days is “SEO fresh,” 90-180 days is “partially SEO optimized,” and over 180 days is “SEO stale.” For outdated WordPress content, one click on “Get Revised Content” lets AI refresh your WordPress posts while preserving existing SEO value – a feature exclusive to our WordPress plugin.

How does Semantic Relevance in WordPress improve SEO rankings?

Semantic Relevance is one of the most powerful yet underutilized WordPress SEO techniques. Our WordPress plugin analyzes your content for topical coverage using LSI (Latent Semantic Indexing) keywords – related terms that Google and other search engines use to determine WordPress content quality and relevance. Unlike basic WordPress SEO plugins that only check for your main keyword, Easy AI SEO identifies the semantic keyword network your WordPress content needs to demonstrate expertise to search engines. WordPress sites with 75% or higher semantic relevance consistently outrank competitors in Google search results, especially after recent Google algorithm updates.

Does this WordPress SEO plugin slow down my WordPress site?

No, Easy AI SEO is engineered for WordPress performance optimization. Unlike other WordPress SEO plugins that can slow page load times, our plugin processes all AI analysis on OpenAI’s servers, not your WordPress hosting. The plugin makes API calls only when you request WordPress SEO analysis, and no scripts are loaded on your WordPress frontend. This approach ensures zero performance impact on WordPress page speed scores – critical for both SEO rankings and user experience on WordPress sites.

How does semantic relevance in WordPress compare to Yoast SEO or Rank Math?

While popular WordPress SEO plugins like Yoast and Rank Math focus primarily on basic keyword density, Easy AI SEO’s semantic relevance analysis leverages advanced AI to identify the complete network of terms Google expects to see in authoritative WordPress content. Our WordPress plugin shows exactly which semantic terms are missing from your content, with specific suggestions for adding them naturally. In comparative tests, WordPress sites optimized with our semantic relevance tool showed an average 23% improvement in search rankings compared to sites using only traditional WordPress SEO plugins, especially for competitive keywords.

How does the WordPress Content Freshness check compare to Yoast SEO and other WordPress SEO plugins?

Easy AI SEO’s Content Freshness analysis goes significantly beyond what other WordPress SEO plugins offer. While some WordPress SEO tools might flag outdated content, only our WordPress plugin provides AI-generated content updates specifically designed to maintain SEO value while adding current information. This exclusive WordPress SEO feature helps maintain rankings for existing WordPress posts without the need to create entirely new content – saving WordPress site owners valuable time while preserving hard-earned search positions that would typically decline with outdated content.
